# Bark Web SDK

These browser bindings are vendored from the published npm package `@secondts/bark@0.25.0` (`bark-0.7.1`). They are served from the same origin as Satoshi.si so wallet code cannot change independently through a CDN.

Upstream: <https://github.com/second-state/bark>

Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@secondts/bark/v/0.25.0>

Files copied from the package's `web/` export:

- `bark_ffi_wasm.js`: `b305e05decbf3e92cfaf975a0ae4cdedba0c47c5e351000b9957986032f58259`
- `bark_ffi_wasm_bg.wasm`: `794b2257ca0bc3bd2f760fb38e1d316c6185e5d8b83ec1b686850f36e92a15ca`

Hashes use SHA-256. See `LICENSE` for the upstream MIT license.
